launchers.name: Aster 1
launchers.description: Fictional light Mars injector; payload capacity is at the stated C3, not LEO.

launchers.name: Aster 2
launchers.description: Fictional medium Mars injector. Higher departure energy and payload.

launchers.name: Aster Heavy
launchers.description: Fictional heavy injector; expensive performance reserve.

transfers.name: Hohmann window
transfers.description: Near circular, coplanar minimum-energy reference. Launch at a suitable planetary alignment.

transfers.name: Fast opportunity
transfers.description: Illustrative faster transfer: more departure energy and harder Mars capture.

transfers.name: Off-window attempt
transfers.description: Illustrative poor alignment: expensive departure and arrival; no ephemeris optimization.

orbits.name: Low mapping
orbits.description: Sharp images but narrow swath. Higher capture delta-v.

orbits.name: Regional mapper
orbits.description: Wider swath and longer period; lower surface resolution.

orbits.name: Elliptical survey
orbits.description: Images at periapsis; long period reduces imaging opportunities.
